556:t_5:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「That wound...! You had it before we fought!」

556:t_5:47.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「$c's ground troops used to be my subordinates. Fighting them would leave me like this.」

556:t_5:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why on earth would you fight me... even with a wound like that!?」

556:t_5:49.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I wanted... to show you... who you are...」

556:t_5:51.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You couldn't finish me off... That's what it means.」

556:t_5:54.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I wanted... to send you home... I wanted to go home, too... To my wife, $$イリーナ$$... and my child...」

556:t_5:56.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I... never told you, either... did I...? My wife... died... in a medical accident... carrying my child...」

556:t_5:57.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is that why you went along with $$レナード$$'s plan!? A man like you, buying into that spineless fantasy!」

556:t_5:58.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Did you... think I was invincible?」

556:t_5:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「Isn't that... what a father is supposed to be!?」

556:t_5:60.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Every father... is like this beneath the surface... Once you realize that... you're finally halfway to being a man...」

556:t_5:67.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar～

556:t_5:69.en:
$n
「I'm going to retrieve $$宗介$$! I'm counting on you to look after $$千鳥$$!」

556:t_5:70.en:
$$甲児$$
「You can't! It's too late now!」

556:t_5:71.en:
$$アルト$$
「He made his own choice... Let's... wait.」

556:t_6:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry... If I synchronized your feelings through the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ with $$レーバテイン$$'s $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$...」

556:t_6:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought it would generate a field that could withstand even a $$時空震動$$...」

556:t_6:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「But $$レーバテイン$$'s cockpit was destroyed, so we couldn't turn $$宗介$$'s will into power...」

556:t_6:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's nobody's fault... Everyone... did everything they could...」

556:t_6:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's... give her some space for now...」

556:t_6:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$宗介$$... When $$ソフィア$$ showed me what was happening outside, I thought you were dead...)

556:t_6:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
(But after I cried my heart out and came to terms with it, I went outside, and you were alive...)

556:t_6:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I was so, so happy... I forgot all the pain and sadness, but... in the end... you were gone...)

556:t_6:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
(It's not fair... If I'd known this would happen... I wish we'd never made that promise...)

556:t_6:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Right up to the very end... you let me down...)

556:t_6:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You war-crazed, gloomy quiet type! You... You!!」

556:t_6:18.en:
???
「How rude. War-crazed and gloomy, perhaps, but I thought I'd stopped being the quiet type long ago.」

556:t_6:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「And I promised before the attack on $$ラース・バビロン$$, too. I said I'd come back alive, no matter what.」

556:t_6:22.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's no problem. I'm alive and well.」

556:t_6:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-you... How did you...!? You weren't supposed to be able to use the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$...」

556:t_6:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「I couldn't, but $$アル$$ did it for me.」

556:t_6:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レーバテイン$$'s cockpit was destroyed, but the core unit was intact.」

556:t_6:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「But even I was surprised. $$アル$$ used the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ on his own to generate a force field...」

556:t_6:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「And everyone's feelings in $c joined it, stopping that $$時空震動$$.」

556:t_6:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's my partner for you. He's got so much guts, it's a shame he's only an AI.」

556:t_6:31.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I'm sorry, $$千鳥$$. I said I'd take you back to our classroom, but my fight isn't over.」

556:t_6:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「It seems I won't be able to return to $$陣代高校$$ for a while yet. So at least you should go ahead...」

556:t_6:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then I'll stay with you as a special member of $c.」

556:t_6:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Or am I worthless now that I'm no longer a $$ウィスパード$$?」

556:t_6:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Now that $$ソフィア$$ is gone, my powers are gradually fading...」

556:t_6:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then I'll just be a high school girl... I don't have $$テッサ$$'s genius for command, so I'll really be an ordinary civilian.」

556:t_6:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Would having someone like that in $c be a nuisance?」

556:t_6:40.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's no problem. I can vouch for your cooking skills. They'll be put to good use in the support team.」

556:t_6:45.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The one where you'd take me to the beach someday?」

556:t_6:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「That one, too, but I mean the one we made in $$ニケーロ$$.」

556:t_6:47.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... Oh... When we meet again, we'd kiss...」

556:t_6:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「As you can see, we've met again.」

556:t_6:52.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But look... $$カレン$$ and $$アルト$$ and the others are running over here...」

556:t_6:53.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't mind, but... here, you know... Everyone will see us, and that's a little...」

556:t_6:55.en:
$$かなめ$$
